title: Games Arcade
strap: Bite-sized challenges, infinite fun — built one game at a time.

games.title: NEW · CyberPulse: Blackout
games.desc: Skim a rain-black megacity at terminal speed. Parry lethal fire, weaponise collapsing infrastructure, and break the Null Warden in a seamless neon assault. WebGL2 rendering with a Canvas fallback, so it still runs where the GPU path is refused. One file, no install, offline. AAA V6.
games.pitch: Steer through enemy fire, parry at impact and charge overdrive by grazing shots.
what_you_do: Drag to steer around incoming fire.
Tap phase at the moment of impact to parry.
Graze enemy fire to charge overdrive.

games.title: Crown & Badge: Frontier Watch
games.desc: Command six border districts through a seeded 30-day strategy campaign. Allocate officers to urgent calls, choose charge, containment or infiltration, build outposts, manage tomorrow’s ledger and carry earned Valor into future watches. One file, no install, plays offline.
games.pitch: Dispatch officers, equip relics and secure three outposts across a 30-day strategy campaign.
what_you_do: Assign ready officers to incidents or drag them onto districts.
Equip a relic on each officer.
Spend earned valor on permanent advantages for future campaigns.

games.title: House Olympiad · Sports V4
games.desc: A V4 local championship dashboard for five disciplines across Aurora Links, Apex Pool, Apex Kick and Global Games. Merge Aurora Links, Apex Pool and Global Games results through the private, on-device Sports Passport, compare House points, and export only when you choose. One file, no account, plays offline.
games.pitch: Collect station scores, compare house totals and export your local championship record.
what_you_do: Import saved results or paste a sync code.
Build a temporary board that totals station scores by house.
Refresh the results or export a collection file.

games.title: Titan Forge: Strength Ascension
games.desc: Rhythm-strength game: three-phase lifts, muscle evolution, Kai duels, LAN rival duels, Divine DNA ascension tree.
games.pitch: Time three-phase lifts, manage muscle fatigue and earn permanent upgrades through training.
what_you_do: Time the drive, brace and control phases of each lift.
Change training focus when a muscle needs rest.
Spend gems on permanent upgrades.

games.title: Emberwild
games.desc: An original creature-collector. Explore the Vale, battle and capture Emberkin, then follow a seam in the rock down into procedurally generated Depths — cavern, ruins, then hybrid — with loot, healing pools and a Depthwarden on the last floor. Before every throw you call your own odds, and the game then shows you the real ones. Fainting costs you the floor, never the run. One file, no install, plays offline.
games.pitch: Explore six regions, make story choices and use timed bonus pulses in untimed creature battles.
what_you_do: Explore routes with stairs, ledges and tall-grass encounters.
Press as the rings meet for optional bonus power in battle.
Make story choices that lead to one of five futures.

games.title: Vector Overdrive: Nova Siege
games.desc: Twin-stick survival in a full 360° arena. Break a living threat budget wave after wave: graze enemy fire to charge your overdrive, evolve one weapon through four tiers, draft upgrades between waves, and hold off a three-phase dreadnought every fifth wave. Keyboard, gamepad or touch sticks; scores stay on your device. One file, no install, plays offline.
games.pitch: Fight arena waves, graze shots for overdrive and evolve your weapon through four tiers.
what_you_do: Move and aim separately while firing at enemy waves.
Choose an upgrade after each completed wave.
Collect three green cores to evolve your weapon.

games.title: Ouroboros: Chronos Unbound
games.desc: Four visionaries and one dying clockwork city. A self-contained anime tactical RPG: break the city's logic, sever its sub-nodes, chain resonance techniques between bound heroes, forge equipment from salvaged materials, climb the Spire, and decide whether a broken timeline deserves preservation — or change. One file, no install, plays offline.
games.pitch: Reposition your party, target enemy parts and choose skills in tactical battles.
what_you_do: Move within the battle radius before committing an action.
Cycle enemy sub-nodes and choose skills or items.
Use flank and rear attacks to bypass armour.

games.title: Global Games: World Stage V4
games.desc: World Stage V4 brings nine fluid sporting events, biomechanical rhythm, weekly cups, earn-only progression and private same-network class play to one offline file. Energy carries between days, personal bests stay on the device, and every control, sound and graphic is generated locally.
games.pitch: Build running rhythm, time jumps and aim arrows across nine sporting events.
what_you_do: Alternate left and right inputs to build a steady running rhythm.
Hold the jump-angle meter and release before crossing the board.
Read wind and sway to aim five arrows.

games.title: Relicforge: Fracture Engine
games.desc: Three realms are breaking apart, and their relic logic is the only way through. Take a Forgeguard, a Riftcaller or a Shadowsmith into Ironwood Verge for its Forge Shards, the Glitchworks for its Fracture Pylons, and the Celestial Foundry for the Nullsmith itself. Temper relics at the forge between fights, read every ground telegraph before it lands, then export a Chronicle of the whole run — a standalone evidence record, generated locally, with no account and no server.
games.pitch: Explore three realms, fight with class-specific attacks and temper equipment at a forge.
what_you_do: Choose a hero discipline with its own attacks and signature ability.
Balance heat and resonance to strengthen forged upgrades.
Probe corrupted channels and restore a stable waveform.

games.title: Neon Turf: Overdrive
games.desc: Rocket-powered hover cars, one ball, and a floor that remembers who drove over it. Score in the net to lead — but every wheel-track paints the grid, and if the clock runs out level the team holding the most turf takes the decision. Three arenas of bumpers, gravity wells and portals: Neon Foundry, Singularity Court and Warp Circuit. Run the Arcade Cup solo, take a Local Duel on one screen, or drill it in the Training Lab.
games.pitch: Drive hover cars, score goals and paint turf to improve grip and boost recharge.
what_you_do: Steer, boost and shoot the core into the goal.
Paint turf to gain grip and recharge boost faster.
Pulse to block a rival or blast the core.

games.title: Echo Vault — Sound Is Your Light
games.desc: A pitch-black vault you can only see by making noise. Every sonar pulse paints the architecture in travelling light — and tells every hunter down there exactly where you are. Read the room before it answers, hold your breath to go cold, or throw a loud ping across the hall and walk the other way while they chase it. Sound is your light and your danger, and choosing when to spend it is the whole game.
games.pitch: Reveal dark rooms with sonar, recover three cores and escape while every sound exposes your position.
what_you_do: Fire sonar pulses to reveal the architecture.
Recover three resonance cores.
Find the active rift and escape.

games.title: Relic Forge: Crownfall — V4 Milestone 2
games.desc: V4 Roadmap Milestone 2 turns Crownfall into a kinetic modular action roguelite: dismantle machine enemies component by component, recover their relics, rebuild your chassis and preserve the best surgical Salvage Rating. One file, no install, plays offline.
games.pitch: Dismantle enemy components, salvage intact parts and rebuild your combat chassis between chambers.
what_you_do: Target separate arms, legs, heads and cores to disable enemy systems.
Keep valuable parts intact so you can recover them at the forge.
Install one recovered component between chambers; dismantle the rest for credits.

games.title: Off-Brand: After Hours — V4 Milestone 2
games.desc: V4 Roadmap Milestone 2 takes the reversible brand-workshop whodunnit After Hours. Follow movement trails, the scene log and Roll Call statements to identify the Glitch without voting anyone out. Designed for Matt's sweet, adorable niece Clara; one file, no install, plays offline.
games.pitch: Complete workshop jobs and compare movement clues, or fake tasks and sabotage while avoiding the patrol.
what_you_do: Complete jobs and repair corrupted machines to finish the commission.
Rewind trails and compare task sparks, skips and seam jumps.
Play the saboteur: fake tasks, corrupt machines and slip through seams.

games.title: Axiom Shift
games.desc: A one-button rhythm runner where the beat is something you see, not hear — a visible pulse you read instead of music, so it plays in a silent classroom and works for a deaf pupil. Four forms with genuinely different physics (jump, gravity-invert, hold-to-fly, flap), six geometric Propositions, a date-seeded Daily Shift that's the same run for the whole class offline, and the opt-in Axiom Rule for the purists. You never lose — a touch smudges and rewinds to the last checkpoint, and your furthest progress is always kept. Offline, no accounts, no sound.
games.pitch: Time jumps, gravity flips and flight to a visible beat, with checkpoints that keep your progress.
what_you_do: Tap to jump or invert gravity as your form changes.
Hold to rise, release to fall, or tap to flap.
Watch the pulse and retry hazards from the last checkpoint.

games.title: Charcoal
games.desc: A short hide-and-seek round in the Made by Matt studio: six shapes, one quietly smudging finished work back to rough with a stick of charcoal, and one carrying the fixative can — a single spray that seals it. Read the charcoal dust, spend your ink drops on a Blot, a Trace or the Studio lights, and two friends re-ink any shape that's gone rough. You rotate through every role and nothing is ever lost for good. Made with love for Matt's niece Clara ♥.
games.pitch: Rotate roles, follow charcoal dust and spend ink to keep the studio finished or catch the hidden smudger.
what_you_do: Follow the charcoal dust to work out who has been smudging.
Spend ink on protection, a dust trace or a brief view of the whole room.
Aim the single spray to stop the smudger; help restore rough shapes.

games.title: Hold the Mark
games.desc: Built mobile-first for phones and tablets. Defend the Made by Matt mark with brand-shape towers, Harmony combos and a calm-play Focus meter. Six levels — including Kerning Run, where the route slides sideways mid-wave — plus thumb gestures, daily challenges, unlockable tower skins and Mark themes. Works offline in any orientation.
games.pitch: Place and upgrade towers, spend limited utilities and charge a focus boost by making measured decisions.
what_you_do: Choose a tower and place it on an open tile.
Upgrade towers, change their targets or sell them between waves.
Build focus between decisions, then trigger six seconds of thinking time.

games.title: Glitch Clash
games.desc: NEW ACT II — the campaign runs to fifteen stages now, ending in the Deep Static. Collect 24 Keepers across the brand shapes, mix your trio for Harmony, then fight through shifting arena modifiers, Glitch Corruption you can ride or purge, Glyph Alchemy hybrid moves, and beam Clashes you win on timing rather than luck. Five animated story moments. Gentle by design, offline-friendly, phone-first.
games.pitch: Build a three-card team, charge energy for specials and time your taps when attacks clash.
what_you_do: Choose three cards; mix three different shapes for a power bonus.
Strike, charge or guard to manage energy before using a special.
Tap as the sweep reaches the bright arc during a clash.

games.title: Trail Runner: Stormbreak V4 — Milestone 2
games.desc: Portable V4 Milestone 2 sends a fast reflex runner through a curved storm corridor. Dodge hazards, build Momentum and challenge a local ghost run in one offline file.
games.pitch: Steer, climb and drop through a curved three-lane course; spin through crates and blast mines.
what_you_do: Steer across three lanes, then climb or drop to clear obstacles.
Spin through crates and blast mines.
Graze hazards and time attacks to trigger a six-second momentum burst.

games.title: VoxelCraft
games.desc: The original prototype — a localized 3D block builder exploring spatial coordinates, geometry, and structural placement. Superseded by Voxel Frontier, the full engine.
games.pitch: Mine blocks, craft tools and build shelter, or race to gather ores in a 60-second arcade round.
what_you_do: Mine materials and craft tools or decorative blocks.
Place blocks to build a roof, then light a campfire before dark.
Try the 60-second ore challenge and collect higher-scoring minerals.

games.title: Vortex
games.desc: A high-intensity tunnel-dodging experience testing rapid peripheral processing and predictive tracking accuracy.
games.pitch: Race a seeded tunnel, skim obstacles for boost and collect relays to absorb a hit.
what_you_do: Steer through the tube and hold boost when you need speed.
Near-miss obstacles or thread gold rings to refill boost.
Collect three blue relays, then use the charge to absorb one hit.

games.title: Globe Snake
games.desc: Snake, but wrapped around a planet. Steer around the globe, stretch your tail longer and hold to sprint — and unlock new skins as you clear planets.
games.pitch: Steer around a sphere, eat orbs and rescue crews while managing your sprint.
what_you_do: Turn left or right and eat orbs to grow and score.
Rescue two crews from cyan rings on each planet; release dash to dock.
Hold sprint for speed and avoid crossing your tail in Classic mode.

games.title: Neon Snake Overdrive
games.desc: A neon snake arena. Steer with the arrow keys, WASD or a swipe, eat to get longer and pick up speed, then put your initials on the high-score table.
games.pitch: Steer for food, avoid collisions and carry energy to three relays.
what_you_do: Steer with arrows, letter keys or swipes; avoid walls and your own body.
Carry food energy to three relays in order, spending two cargo at each.
Spend one cargo on a boost that lifts the amber gates for 18 moves.

games.title: Neon Siege
games.desc: A localized matrix defense challenge requiring calculated tactical placement and rapid prioritization under pressure.
games.pitch: Build and upgrade towers, route reactor power and defend the core through fifteen waves.
what_you_do: Pick a tower and build it on a tile to stop enemies reaching the core.
Spend credits from defeated enemies to build or upgrade towers.
Reassign three power sockets or spend power on a temporary damage and range boost.

games.title: Neon Garden
games.desc: An ambient, low-arousal pattern-generation loop designed for focus conditioning and cognitive pacing.
games.pitch: Plant glowing seeds, collect motes and discover hybrids in a garden with no clock or losing.
what_you_do: Tap the ground to plant your selected seed.
Collect motes from blooming plants to buy seeds and water.
Grow different species side by side to discover mystery seed pods.

games.title: Orbital
games.desc: A physics-based gravitational simulation mapping kinetic momentum, planetary vectors, and circular mechanics.
games.pitch: Slingshot a probe around gravity wells, collect stars and reach each goal in as few shots as possible.
what_you_do: Drag from the probe to set aim and power, then release to launch.
Read the dotted trajectory preview as gravity bends your shot.
Collect bonus stars and use one mid-flight boost per shot.

games.title: Grid Chase
games.desc: A high-speed coordinate grid maze testing rapid directional corrections and immediate geometric mapping layout transitions.
games.pitch: Collect every pip in a hunted maze, use power cores and dodge shockwaves before striking the boss.
what_you_do: Move through the maze and collect every pip while four hunters close in.
Grab power cores to turn the tables and eat the hunters.
Dodge the boss shockwaves, then ram its glowing cyan core three times.

games.title: Prism
games.desc: A perspective-shifting puzzle manipulating light angles, alignment paths, and spatial refraction lines.
games.pitch: Place and rotate mirrors and splitters to light every target with matching coloured beams.
what_you_do: Pick a piece from the tray and tap a cell to place it.
Tap a placed mirror or splitter to rotate it; remove pieces to try another route.
Mix beams where they meet and match the colours of every target.

games.title: Grapple
games.desc: A momentum-centric physics playground focusing on vector hook connections and conservation of kinetic energy.
games.pitch: Hook anchors, release into flight and collect sparks to cut your time across six stages.
what_you_do: Hold to hook the highlighted anchor, then release at the top of your arc.
Collect sparks to cut 0.3 seconds each from your time and chain swings for combos.
Use gold anchors and rings for speed while avoiding cracked anchors that break.

games.title: Marble
games.desc: A tilt-and-gravity simulator testing meticulous physical adjustment, balancing thresholds, and micro-coordination.
games.pitch: Tilt a sky maze, roll to the beacon and chase gems and par times while staying clear of the edges.
what_you_do: Tilt the maze with keys, dragging or device tilt to roll toward the beacon.
Pass through checkpoint rings and collect gems on side paths.
Read ice, rubber and boost surfaces to beat the par time for a medal.

games.title: Slipstream
games.desc: A streamlined rhythmic velocity test tracking uninterrupted forward momentum and rapid gap synchronization.
games.pitch: Draft behind rivals, charge your boost and deliver three signal packets through gates each lap.
what_you_do: Steer, brake and boost through a three-lap race.
Draft behind rivals to charge boost, then slingshot past on a straight.
Hit alternating gate lines to deliver three packets and earn a surge.

games.title: Slipstream - GP
games.desc: Climb the eight-rival ladder — draft, slingshot, overtake. Touch controls with a brake, garage upgrades, daily sprint, and a velocity–time graph in school mode.
games.pitch: Climb a rival ladder, draft for boost and manage a speed wing that heats up on straights.
what_you_do: Beat each rival on their home track to climb the ladder.
Hold the aero wing open on straights; close it before turns.
Brake and draft to cool the wing before overheating cuts your power.

games.title: Wrecking Crew
games.desc: A destructive physics environment evaluating structural integrity, mass distributions, and center-of-gravity impacts.
games.pitch: Inspect structures, place charges and bring them down while keeping protected assets clear.
what_you_do: Orbit the structure and inspect load paths before choosing an intervention.
Tap blocks to place charges, or tap a charge to remove it.
Slide the crane rail and swing the wrecking ball with directional controls.

games.title: Lumins
games.desc: A Lemmings-style rescue puzzle: assign roles to your Lumins to dig, build and bridge them safely to the exit — complete with a full level editor.
games.pitch: Place bridges, tunnels and turning fields to guide walkers safely to the exit.
what_you_do: Place a bridge across gaps so walkers can reach the portal.
Carve shafts or sideways tunnels to open a route.
Paint, test and share your own rescue level.

games.title: Static
games.desc: The newest addition to the arcade — a fresh reflex-and-focus challenge for quick brain-break sessions.
games.pitch: Examine clues, test accounts and assemble a case backed by evidence.
what_you_do: Examine clues and play recordings to inspect the evidence.
Link a clue to an account to test whether it confirms or contradicts the claim.
Combine clues, compare theories and choose the culprit, method and motive.

games.title: One Guy
games.desc: A solo ghost-runner: each attempt races the recorded 'ghost' of the last run on this device, so you race your own past best rather than anyone else. Shareable ghost codes let a run be passed on.
games.pitch: Time short hops and high jumps to outrun a recorded ghost and return boss projectiles.
what_you_do: Tap to jump; hold for height or release early for a short hop.
Pass the spot where the recorded ghost fell to take the crown.
Land on top of boss orbs to send them back and open the gate.

games.title: The Last Lighthouse
games.desc: A keeper survival game: hold the last lighthouse watch by watch, guiding vessels safely through storms and Tempest conditions. Earn Keeper Marks, build your Keeper Record, and explore the new archipelago map — now updated to v1.1 with portable backup codes so progress can move between devices.
games.pitch: Paint remembered light routes and manage lamp wear to guide vessels safely home.
what_you_do: Aim and hold to paint glowing routes that vessels remember and follow.
Switch wide and focused lenses to charge stones and light old glass.
Douse before the lamp seizes, then choose cooling, charging or alignment.

games.title: Kids vs Staff: Showdown
games.desc: Whole-class team quiz: your class takes on the staff across scored rounds. Teams score, not individuals — no individual leaderboard.
games.pitch: Choose quiz, drawing and challenge rounds, then score two competing teams.
what_you_do: Pick at least thirty minutes of rounds for the show.
Guess a number before the reveal; the closest team wins the point.
Draw on the screen while your team guesses against a sixty-second clock.

games.title: World Cup: Road to the Three Lions Final
games.desc: An end-of-term tournament your teacher runs: three nations, possession and steals, stadium codes, a VAR twist and a cooperative England final. Auto-tallied scoring and evidence print included.
games.pitch: Answer team challenges, steal points and join forces for three final missions.
what_you_do: Answer for the squad in possession; other squads can steal after a miss.
Arrange the tactics cards in order and discard the two decoys.
Consult your squad, then choose a goal zone for the final penalty.

games.title: World Cup v3 — Match Director
games.desc: Run a match as director — Made by Matt arcade.
games.pitch: Direct team challenges, award goals and guide the class through a cooperative final.
what_you_do: Reveal answers, judge the quiz and award a goal for each correct response.
Order the six tactics cards and discard the decoys.
Describe a word without using its banned words before the card vanishes.

games.title: World Cup v5 — Showdown
games.desc: Head-to-head showdown — Made by Matt arcade.
games.pitch: Pit attackers against defenders, choose a challenge and contest team goals and clean sheets.
what_you_do: Choose the attacking and defending squads for a head-to-head challenge.
Let the defenders choose a challenge and an optional pressure condition.
Earn goals as attackers or aim for a clean sheet as defenders.

games.title: Trekkers Trail Runner — Tees Coast
games.desc: Five legs of the real AQA Walking Unit route, from Eston Rec to South Gare — set a bearing at the Rec, climb to Eston Nab, then take the dunes and loose sand at the coast. Glide the route, dodge the bog and beat the Storm; Calm Mode is there if you want the walk without the weather.
games.pitch: Steer past trail hazards and tune rescue rings through a finite three-sector route.
what_you_do: Steer left or right, climb and drop to follow the path.
Chain pace pickups to build a streak up to ten.
Tune nine of twelve rings; spend fifteen radio to clear nearby hazards.

games.title: Voxel Frontier: Beaconfall — V4 Milestone 2
games.desc: V4 Roadmap Milestone 2 adds greedy-meshed terrain, bounded flowing water, adaptive visuals and Arcade Passport feats while preserving Creative mode, procedural caves, trees, swimming and per-world saves. Runs offline in the browser.
games.pitch: Build and explore an unlimited block sandbox, or complete contracts to earn marks.
what_you_do: Break and place blocks to reshape your world.
Fly, sprint, jump and swim as you explore.
Choose contracts, complete objectives and earn marks.

games.title: Apex Kick: World Stage
games.desc: Nine modes in one offline free-kick game: World Tour, Pro Free Kicks, 60s Time Attack, Corner Kick Whip, Keeper Glove Mode, Top Bins Blitz, Cross & Volley, Woodwork and a 2P pass-and-play shootout. Swipe to strike and bend the ball past the wall and keeper.
games.pitch: Swipe to strike and bend free kicks, corners and volleys in nine modes.
what_you_do: Swipe up from the ball to take your shot.
Flick to strike, bowing the gesture to bend the ball.
Take turns with a friend on one device in the 2P shootout.

games.title: Apex Pool
games.desc: Call the cue ball's leave, then prove you can read the table. Offline 8-ball with genuine spin, position play, AI, trick shots and an honest Leave Rating.
games.pitch: Call where the cue ball will finish, then use aim and spin to play the table.
what_you_do: Call where the cue ball will finish before you take the shot.
Adjust draw, follow and sidespin to control the cue ball.
Solve ten position-play puzzles and earn three-star ratings.

session_modes.note: The starting clock extends after pots; no maximum session duration is stated.

games.title: Apex Golf
games.desc: A top-down golf game about reading the hole and knowing your own game. Call your stroke count, play nine seeded holes with honest wind and slope, then earn a Call Rating. Works offline.
games.pitch: Read wind and slope, call your stroke count and play nine seeded golf holes.
what_you_do: Study the hole and call how many strokes you will need.
Choose one of four clubs, then set your aim and power.
Play nine seeded holes with wind, slope, sand and water.

games.title: Apex Tennis
games.desc: Call the point before the serve, then build it on court. A complete offline tennis game with real rules, three rival styles and an honest Plan Rating.
games.pitch: Call how a tennis point will unfold, then move, aim and choose shots to follow your plan.
what_you_do: Call how the point will unfold and earn a rating for following the plan.
Move, aim and choose from drive, slice, lob, drop and smash shots.
Practise serve width, rally depth and net approaches in three drills.

games.title: Neon Sync
games.desc: A 3v3 neon point-control arena where the score is not your aim — what counts is whether you were the teammate everyone wants. Hold the point, back your squad and get endorsed by AI teammates who state their reasons. Bots have human reaction times and cannot out-track you, so matches are decided by reading the fight rather than by twitch.
games.pitch: Hold a point or escort a payload, combining abilities with your team.
what_you_do: Capture the point and race the opposing team to one hundred percent.
Escort the payload to delivery, or defend until the five-minute horn.
Aim primary attacks and combine two abilities with an ultimate.

games.title: Biopunk Hive
games.desc: A single-file biopunk incremental game: grow a forbidden containment hive, harvest cadence, manage toxicity and stabilise breaches before they spread, then distil cryo-stasis condensate and prestige into a stronger run.
games.pitch: Harvest to a steady rhythm, manage toxicity and purge the hive for permanent upgrades.
what_you_do: Keep harvest taps between 220 and 450 milliseconds to amplify yield.
Spend credits to reduce toxicity and contamination risk.
Purge the current hive to claim permanent mutagens while lifetime bonuses survive.

games.title: Neon Breach
games.desc: Survive escalating drone waves in a procedural neon arena. Three weapons — Pulse Rifle, Arc Scattergun and Ion Rail — each want a different range, and eight perks are drafted after every wave clear into a build you choose rather than one you unlock. Full touch controls, and it pauses itself when you switch away.
games.pitch: Survive drone waves, switch weapons and draft a tactical upgrade after every clear.
what_you_do: Move, aim, fire, jump and crouch to survive escalating drone waves.
Switch between three weapons and reload during combat.
Choose one tactical upgrade after each clear; duplicate perks can stack.

games.title: Apex Rally
games.desc: Read the court before the ball arrives. A rally duel against opponents who adapt as you learn them — aim, time and spin every shot, bank Apex Focus by reading the bounce early, then finish the point from the baseline or at the net. Works offline.
games.pitch: Read the court, choose a landing target and time spin shots against adaptive opponents.
what_you_do: Move early to the predicted landing area to charge your focus meter.
Choose a target, hold to charge, then release as the ball enters racket range.
Switch between flat, topspin, slice and lob to shape each rally.

games.title: Medevac Frontier
games.desc: Train with Unit 734, then fly Twilight and Night Canyon medevac runs. Land in the green zone, guide the litter teams out under a running clock — three litters a trip — then decide how many supply crates to risk before you clear the rim. Every completed mission tightens the canyon, and your service record carries over. Works offline.
games.pitch: Land in a canyon, time the patient extraction and take off before the weather window closes.
what_you_do: Control pitch and centreline to land gently on the strip.
Tap when the marker crosses the green zone to move each patient quickly.
Choose how many supply crates to load before a heavier takeoff.

games.title: Lumina Haven
games.desc: A low-pressure sanctuary game about arranging a beautiful room, nurturing unusual plants, collecting gems and crafting luminous new décor. Set the greenhouse weather, repaint the walls and resize the room, then take two materials to the Botanical & Gem Fusion bench — known pairings unlock rare living décor, dyes and lights, and experimental ones still make essence. The Soundscape Mixer is generated live by Web Audio with no sound files, and Photo Mode exports the room only, no interface.
games.pitch: Arrange a room, care for plants and combine collected materials to unlock new décor.
what_you_do: Choose furniture, drag it into place, then rotate or recolour it.
Water plants, let them grow and prune them for rewards.
Collect flowers and gems, then fuse two materials to unlock rare décor.

games.title: Aurora Links: Northern Lights Tour — AAA V4
games.desc: AAA V4 is a standalone WebGL2-enhanced golf simulation with RK4 aerodynamics, dynamic lies, weekly cups, an earn-only career, a shared Sports Passport and private local-network House Cup play. Canvas gameplay remains available when WebGL2 is unavailable.
games.pitch: Read the course, call your score and use a three-tap swing to play each hole.
what_you_do: Aim your shot and control the swing with three timed taps.
Read wind, lies and greens before choosing your shot.
Design a hole by placing its pin, lakes, bunkers and trees.

games.title: Neon Meridian: Open Drive
games.desc: Free driving in Meridian Bay, a dense original coastal city built for landmarks, traffic and discovery. Take delivery runs, checkpoint runs and circuit races, bank the credits, then spend them in the garage on engine, tyres and brakes. Twelve landmarks across seven districts, weather and a day-night sky, holdable on one phone. Offline, single file, no account.
games.pitch: Explore a city by car, complete delivery and checkpoint runs, then upgrade your vehicle.
what_you_do: Drive through traffic and discover landmarks around the city.
Start a delivery, checkpoint run or three-lap circuit race.
Spend challenge credits on engine, tyre and brake upgrades.

games.title: Rally Vector 3D — Championship Edition
games.desc: A six-stage rally season on tarmac, sand, snow, wet coast, forest gravel and canyon shale. Read the holographic pace notes, keep it out of the fords and the breakable props, then spend your service-park minutes on the damage that matters. Every stage records a ghost you can race yourself against. Offline, single file, touch controls.
games.pitch: Race mixed-surface rally stages, compare your ghost and choose repairs between championship stages.
what_you_do: Steer, brake and handbrake through stages with different grip and weather.
Challenge your local best ghost in a time attack.
Spend limited service time repairing damage during the six-stage championship.

games.title: Slipstream GP: Hyperdraft
games.desc: Drafting rebuilt as three zones you can feel: a turbulent fringe, a vacuum pocket that charges your boost, and dirty air that takes your grip and cooks the engine. Pull sideways out of the pocket and the slingshot fires. Four circuits including Stormline, where standing water, hydroplaning and lightning fight you the whole way round. Four rival personalities — the Blocker, the Apex Purist, the Leech and the Wildcard — and any of them will hold a grudge after contact. Offline, no account, nothing uploaded.
games.pitch: Draft rivals, charge boost and pull sideways for slingshot passes in three-lap races.
what_you_do: Hold the slipstream to charge boost, then slingshot past a rival.
Choose a circuit for a three-lap race.
Beat each rival on their home circuit to climb the ladder.

games.title: Apex Curl
games.desc: Call the shot, then throw it. A deterministic curling sheet where ice temperature, pebble wear and the scratch left by earlier stones all move the rock, and sweeping is a real decision rather than a button. Read the draw, judge the weight, and watch the predictor line against what the stone actually does. Works offline.
games.pitch: Call a curling shot, set its speed and angle, then sweep ahead of the moving stone.
what_you_do: Choose release speed, angle and the direction of spin.
Sweep left and right ahead of the stone to reduce drag.
Build an ice puzzle by placing and dragging stones.

games.title: Apex Velodrome
games.desc: Track racing where the match you have is the one you spend. Ride the bankings with real aerodynamics, draft that you can feel arriving, and an anaerobic reserve that does not come back. Points races, the Madison hand-sling, keirin and pursuit, against riders who read the race as you do. Works offline.
games.pitch: Choose a track race, manage power and sprint while judging draft and lane position.
what_you_do: Choose a sprint duel, keirin, team pursuit or a 1 km ghost.
Adjust power and lane to manage drag and your energy reserve.
Sprint, brake or trigger a tactical action during the race.

games.title: Micro-Tinkerer: The Giant's Study
games.desc: Shrunk to thumb height in a giant's study, with three AA batteries to recover — one down in the Lowlands, one on the desktop, one along a bookshelf. A Seeker hunts you the whole time, and you carry an exposure meter that fills when you are in the open and a stamina meter that empties when you run. The room is your other move: an angle lamp, a tub of PVA, a desk fan, a line of hardcover books stood on end. Hiders prevail if one of them is still loose at the end. Up to four players share a six-character room code, and single player runs fully offline.
games.pitch: Hide from a searching light, recover three batteries or explore the room without a timer.
what_you_do: Break the searching light’s sightline and survive the four-minute hunt.
Find three batteries to power the toy plane at the window.
Explore drawer, ruler, vent and cable routes without a timer.

games.title: Town Life
games.desc: A whole town to live in. Claim a plot, furnish a home and wire its electrical grid, buy and upgrade businesses, tune a car, and take any of seven roles — Resident, Courier, Paramedic, Officer, Builder, Mayor or Mischief. Day and night, weather, police patrols, a civic budget the town votes on, and a save that keeps everything between visits. One file, no install, offline. Gold Master v1.0 preview — verified in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. Physical device checks (Chromebook, phone) are still pending.
games.pitch: Choose a town role, complete its jobs, furnish a home and manage businesses and utilities.
what_you_do: Walk or drive around town and interact with people and buildings.
Complete role jobs using cargo handling, pulse timing or evidence scans.
Furnish a home and wire appliances to powered circuits.

games.title: Touchline Dynasty
games.desc: A complete football management career in one file. Take Harbour FC through seasons of transfers, contracts, board expectations and a dressing room that remembers how you treat it — then watch every fixture play out in a live 3D broadcast you can pause, replay from any angle and analyse. Tactics, substitutions and press conferences all move the simulation. Saves stay on your device. Offline, phone-first, no install.
games.pitch: Manage a football club across seasons, from recruitment and finances to tactics and substitutions.
what_you_do: Recruit players, develop youth and manage contracts and facilities.
Change mentality, pressing and player roles during a match.
Choose team talks and press answers that affect the club.

games.title: Skybreak Vector
games.desc: Fly beneath a hostile radar floor, dismantle an offshore cruiser under flak and CIWS fire, then defeat Strider Squadron's prototype ace. Three airframes, a Hydra special-weapon armoury, medals and liveries to unlock, and a phone you can pair as a HOTAS over local Wi-Fi with no cloud relay. WebGL 2 cinematic 3D in one file: no install, offline.
games.pitch: Fly below radar, attack a cruiser and fight an ace across three combat phases.
what_you_do: Control pitch, roll, yaw and throttle to fly beneath the radar floor.
Fire cannon, lock missiles and use equipped special weapons.
Cycle targets and release countermeasures during combat.
